The proposal is to **empirically measure and compare an intervention’s effects on both AI safety and general capabilities**, rather than relying on intuition or appeals to authority. (https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.12001)

The mechanism is to determine whether safety improves **relative to general capabilities**: an apparent safety improvement may simply reflect a more capable AI, without reducing overall risk. Comparing both measures helps distinguish genuine safety progress from capabilities advances misleadingly presented as safety research (“safetywashing”). (https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.12001)
